data.title: ETH Is One Small Dip Away From Trouble, But Analyst Calls Ethereum’s Strength Against Bitcoin ‘Incredibly Positive’
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) traders are under pressure as leveraged positions on the asset are at risk of being liquidated by small price swings. Bears may be forced to cover their shorts if Ethereum pumps up, but bulls could be exposed to further declines. The pressure arrives at a time when macro analyst Mich…
